rappel_detail.anchor: long-standing fixed anchor on slung chockstones (natural, not bolted)
rappel_detail.station: A step low on the Southeast Ridge that is awkward to downclimb, below the horns where a short Class 3+ downclimb crosses between the first two.
rappel_detail.notes: The one rappel, about 25 m, landing on Class 2 ledges. Then continue down the ridge and talus toward Red Pass or into Commonwealth Basin.

set.rappels: One rappel of about 25 m from slung chockstones down an awkward step on the Southeast Ridge descent
